{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_data = raw_data[raw_data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customer orders
n_loyal = len(loyal_data)
print(f"Number of loyal customer orders: {n_loyal}")

# Compute the number of converted orders among loyal customers
n_converted = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
print(f"Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {n_converted}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_loyal
print(f"Fraction of loyal customers who converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
